title: Chatty empty-nester curious about downsizing
scenario: Talkative woman whose kids moved out is curious whether downsizing to a condo makes sense. She is clearly just curious and drifts into small talk.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi, is this Lorraine? This is Felix with Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Felix! Yes, hi, hello. Oh, I'm so glad it's a real person. I hate those robot calls.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ha, me too. How's your day going?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Oh, it's lovely. I just got back from water aerobics. Have you ever tried it? It's wonderful for the knees.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I haven't, but now I'm tempted. So I saw you were asking about a condo purchase?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Well, I was curious, that's all. My youngest just moved to Denver and the house feels enormous. I'm not ready to do anything, I'm just wondering what's out there.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's a great reason to start thinking about it. How long have you been in the house?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Twenty-six years. We raised all four kids there.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Wow. Is there still a mortgage on it?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: A tiny one. Maybe forty thousand left.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: So you'd likely have quite a bit of equity to put toward a condo.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I'd think so. My friend Dot sold hers and bought a place by the lake. She has a balcony. I'm a little jealous.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ha, a balcony is hard to beat. Would you plan to sell first and then buy?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I suppose I'd have to. But honestly, I'm only curious at this point. My daughter thinks I'm being impulsive.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Totally fair, it's a big decision. Would it help if I put together a simple overview of how a sell-then-buy usually works, no strings attached?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Oh, that would be nice. Could you mail it? My printer's broken.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Of course. And would you like me to check back in a couple months?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: That would be fine.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Great. Enjoy the rest of your day, Lorraine.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: You too, Felix. Try the water aerobics!
